mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS cart_item_id, v.product_id, v.id AS variant_id, p.name AS product_name, v.price AS unit_price, c.quantity, v.price * c.quantity AS line_total FROM cart_items c JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = c.variant_id JOIN products p ON p.id = v.product_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id
